# Public UUID Array fixture

`part/` is a byte-for-byte stock MergeTree part generated by the official
ClickHouse local `26.7.1.1315` build. It was made in a fresh scratch store with
synthetic UUID data and the exact schema `pk UInt64`, `plain Array(UUID)`, and
`maybe Array(Nullable(UUID))`, sorted by `pk`. ClickHouse `CHECK TABLE` passed
before the part was copied into this fixture.

The source table used `index_granularity = 2`, `index_granularity_bytes =
10485760`, `enable_mixed_granularity_parts = 1`, `min_rows_for_wide_part = 0`,
`min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0`, `compress_marks = 0`,
`min_compress_block_size = 0`, `max_compress_block_size = 4096`,
`ratio_of_defaults_for_sparse_serialization = 1.0`, and
`default_compression_codec = 'LZ4'`. The part has seven rows with sorted keys
`1, 2, 4, 6, 9, 11, 13`; mark row counts are `2, 2, 2, 1` plus the EOF
sentinel. Plain adaptive marks are stored as `.mrk2`.

The UUID payloads were inserted from these canonical values:

```text
A = 00112233-4455-6677-8899-aabbccddeeff
B = 61f0c404-5cb3-11e7-907b-a6006ad3dba0
C = 01234567-89ab-cdef-fedc-ba9876543210
D = 10203040-5060-7080-90a0-b0c0d0e0f001
zero = 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
max = ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff
```

`plain` rows are `[], [A, zero], [max], [], [B], [C, D], []`. `maybe` rows
are `[], [NULL, zero], [NULL, NULL], [], [C], [NULL, B], []`. This includes
an all-NULL non-empty array and adjacent non-NULL UUIDs. The asymmetric `A`
value discriminates UUID half ordering: the expected little-endian bytes are
`77 66 55 44 33 22 11 00 ff ee dd cc bb aa 99 88` (high UInt64 first, then
low UInt64).

The stock part reported `columns_substreams.txt` topology `pk`; `plain.size0`,
`plain`; `maybe.size0`, `maybe.null`, `maybe`. Its serialization metadata is
`{"columns":[],"propagate_types_serialization_versions_to_nested_types":true,"types_serialization_versions":{"string":1},"version":1}`.
`SHA256SUMS` pins all files copied from that part. This fixture is public,
synthetic test data and evidence only for the pinned ClickHouse build and part
profile; it does not establish compatibility with other versions or layouts.
